old: A ring and a C=C each remove 2 H from the alkane formula, so an open-chain alkene has the same formula as a cycloalkane. 1-Hexene is C6H12; hexane is C6H14, cyclohexene C6H10 and benzene C6H6.
new: A ring and a C=C each remove 2 H from the alkane formula, so an open-chain alkene with one C=C has the same formula as a cycloalkane. 1-Hexene is C6H12; hexane is C6H14, and 1,5-hexadiene (two C=C) and 1-hexyne (one C≡C) are both C6H10.
